SELECT t1.CORP_GR , TO_CHAR(t1.GYUL_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS gyul_ymd , t1.FUND_CD , ia.FUND_NM AS xx_fund_cd , gs.MRD_NM , t1.TUJA_AEK , t1.TUJA_PJ , t1.NAV , t1.SONIK , t1.PJ_SUIK_PER , t1.TOTAL_BOSU , t1.BASIC_BOSU , t1.SUCCESS_BOSU , gs.PRE_BASIC , gs.BASIC_PER , gs.BM_PER , gs.SUCCESS_PER , t1.DOC_NO , t1.PRODUCT_NM , t1.CONTRACT_CONDITION , t1.SEND_MAIL_ADDR , t1.SEND_CC_ADDR , TO_CHAR(t1.SEND_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS send_dt , t1.SEND_USER , gs.CONTRACT_AEK , t1.RECONTRACT_AEK , t1.WM_SEOLJ_AEK , t1.WM_SONIK , t1.HAEJI_SAYU , 'a' AS tbl_gb FROM SKT1GS_INDATA t1 LEFT JOIN SKT1GS gs ON gs.corp_gr = t1.CORP_GR AND gs.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd AND gs.gyul_ymd = t1.gyul_ymd JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr}
AND t1.gyul_ymd >= TO_DATE(#{gyulYmd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
UNION ALL SELECT t1.CORP_GR , TO_CHAR(t1.GYUL_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS gyul_ymd , t1.FUND_CD , ia.FUND_NM AS xx_fund_cd , NULL AS MRD_NM , t1.TUJA_AEK , t1.TUJA_PJ , t1.NAV , t1.SONIK , t1.PJ_SUIK_PER , t1.TOTAL_BOSU , t1.BASIC_BOSU , t1.SUCCESS_BOSU , t1.PRE_BASIC , t1.BASIC_PER , t1.BM_PER , t1.SUCCESS_PER , t1.DOC_NO , t1.PRODUCT_NM , t1.CONTRACT_CONDITION , NULL AS SEND_MAIL_ADDR , NULL AS SEND_CC_ADDR , NULL AS send_dt , NULL AS SEND_USER , t1.CONTRACT_AEK , t1.RECONTRACT_AEK , t1.WM_SEOLJ_AEK , t1.WM_SONIK , NULL AS HAEJI_SAYU , 'b' AS tbl_gb FROM SKT1GS t1 JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr}
AND t1.gyul_ymd >= TO_DATE(#{gyulYmd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND #{chk} = 'b'
ORDER BY xx_fund_cd ASC, gyul_ymd DESC, tbl_gb ASC
ORDER BY gyul_ymd DESC, xx_fund_cd ASC, tbl_gb ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE SKT1GS_INDATA SET basic_bosu = #{basicBosu}, success_bosu = #{successBosu}, total_bosu = #{totalBosu}, recontract_aek = #{recontractAek}, wm_seolj_aek = #{wmSeoljAek}, wm_sonik = #{wmSonik}, doc_no = #{docNo}, haeji_sayu = #{haejiSayu}, send_mail_addr = #{sendMailAddr}, send_cc_addr = #{sendCcAddr}, product_nm = #{productNm}, contract_condition = #{contractCondition}, send_dt = SYSDATE WHERE corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND gyul_ymd = TO_DATE(#{gyulYmd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND fund_cd = #{fundCd}
